assistant|premiere_tip_timeline_panel: Master the Timeline Panel: customize tracks, track heights, track patching, clip grouping
assistant|premiere_tip_render_cache: Manage the render cache via Preferences, Render and Replace, and purging the cache
assistant|premiere_tip_lumetri_color: Learn the Lumetri Color Panel: color wheels, curves, and Color Match feature
assistant|premiere_tip_audio: Explore audio advanced settings: Audio Clip Mixer, Dynamics and EQ plugins, Audio Gain and Normalize
assistant|premiere_tip_effects: Customize effects/transitions via Effect Controls; try third-party plugins like Video Copilot's Orb
assistant|premiere_tip_dynamic_link: Use Dynamic Link to integrate with After Effects for motion graphics, 3D animations, visual effects
assistant|premiere_tip_proxy_media: Understand proxy media, ingest settings, and Media Encoder batch processing
assistant|premiere_tip_multicam: Learn multi-camera editing: multi-camera sequences, syncing angles, Multi-Camera Monitor
assistant|premiere_tip_export: Familiarize with export formats, codecs, settings, and Media Encoder batch exporting
assistant|premiere_tip_practice: Practice and experiment; start with small projects and progress to complex ones
assistant|premiere_resource_official_doc: Recommends Adobe Premiere Pro official documentation and tutorials
assistant|premiere_resource_youtube: Recommends YouTube channels: Premiere Bro, Video Copilot, Adobe Creative Cloud
assistant|premiere_resource_courses: Recommends online courses on Udemy, LinkedIn Learning, and Skillshare
assistant|premiere_resource_communities: Recommends communities: Reddit's r/premierepro and Adobe's Premiere Pro forum
assistant|color_match_definition: Color Match automatically matches the color and tone of a Source clip to a Reference clip
assistant|color_match_adjustments: Color Match adjusts color tone, skin tones, exposure, and contrast of the Source clip
assistant|color_match_use_cases: Color Match use cases: matching different camera angles, different scenes, and archive footage
assistant|creative_panel_purpose: Creative panel: intuitive/visual tool for broad creative adjustments and applying pre-built looks
assistant|curves_panel_purpose: Curves panel: technical tool with Luma, Color, and Hue vs. Saturation curves for precise control
assistant|cinematic_tip_s_curve: Create a gentle S-curve: shadows point at 20-30% x-axis, highlights point at 70-80% x-axis
assistant|cinematic_tip_black_levels: Drag the bottom-left curve point down to ~10-20% y-axis to crush blacks for depth
assistant|cinematic_tip_shoulder: Add a shoulder: point at 90-95% x-axis dragged down slightly for filmic highlight roll-off
assistant|cinematic_tip_midtones: Enhance midtones: add a point around 50% x-axis and drag it up slightly
assistant|cinematic_tip_color_curve: Use the Color Curve to add warmth or coolness or create a specific color palette
assistant|cinematic_tip_hue_saturation: Use Hue vs. Saturation Curve to create specific color looks like warm golden or cool blue tones
assistant|cinematic_tip_reference: Study other filmmakers' work and use reference images/videos to guide grading
assistant|toe_control: Toe adjusts the curve in shadows (0-20%): toe in lifts blacks/reduces contrast; toe out crushes blacks/increases contrast
assistant|shoulder_control: Shoulder adjusts the curve in highlights (80-100%): shoulder in softens roll-off; shoulder out brightens highlights
assistant|grading_workflow: Workflow: base look via Creative panel presets, refine with Curves, balance levels, local adjustments, then fine-tune
assistant|lumetri_vs_legacy_tools: Lumetri Color Panel is advanced/intuitive/creative; Legacy Color Grading tools are traditional/technical/precise
assistant|color_wheels_overview: Color Wheels: three wheels for shadows, midtones, highlights to adjust hue, saturation, luminance of targeted colors
assistant|grading_best_practice_neutral: Start color grading with a neutral grade to get a clean slate
assistant|grading_best_practice_color_sp: Work in a consistent color space such as Rec. 709 or DCI-P3
assistant|grading_best_practice_color_sc: Establish a color script outlining the palette, tone, and mood before grading
assistant|grading_best_practice_dark_to_: Work from dark to light: adjust shadows and midtones before highlights
assistant|grading_best_practice_subtle: Make subtle adjustments; avoid drastic changes in color grading
assistant|grading_best_practice_referenc: Reference footage and color grade regularly while working
assistant|grading_best_practice_consiste: Maintain a consistent look and feel throughout the video
